neighbours.label: The digits of a year after ' in', following a stated quantity or share ('only 12% had used it in 2015', '34 million worldwide in 2011'); ' in' with a month or a place, numbers that are not years, and a year with no quantity before it stay lower.
fire: Just 9% had tried the app in 2014, but this grew.
About 21 million people were out of work worldwide in 2009.
Nearly 40% of homes had a phone in 1960.
Only 15% of voters backed him in 2004, yet he won.
Roughly 80 million tourists came to France in 2012.
Some 3% of firms had a website in 1996.
Over 60 million people lived with the disease in 2013.
Only 7% of farms had power in 1930.
quiet: Just 9% had tried the app in Spain, but this grew.
About 21 million people were out of work worldwide last spring.
Nearly 40% of homes had a phone in June.
The old bridge fell down in 2004.
Roughly 80 million tourists came to France that summer.
Some 3% of firms had a website in Peru.
My aunt moved to the coast in 2013.
Only 7 farms had power in town.

notes: Probes: 0.12-0.35, peaks mostly on digits, so the median is at risk. The card's top example (the urban area in 1990) has no statistic, so that clause is a test, not a finding; two near misses have a year without a quantity. ' ' before a year is the card's peak (x15), but this pole's reading of it in probes was weaker than the digits'. Near misses 0.02-0.07.
